s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute neurological decline with mass effect and subsequent respiratory decompensation in an immunocompromised host
salient_findings: Ring-enhancing lesion in the right temporal lobe with mass effect
Elevated serum toxoplasma IgG and positive toxoplasma DNA-PCR in CSF
New left upper lobe opacification with diffuse reticulonodular interstitial prominence on chest radiograph
key_facts: 1½-week history of headache and blurred vision
MRI showed a 2.7-cm ring-enhancing lesion in the right temporal lobe
HIV infection with a CD4 count <20 cells/µL
HIV viral load of 191 000 copies/mL
Elevated serum toxoplasma IgG
CSF studies showed 48 cells/µL (97% lymphocytes) with positive toxoplasma IgG and DNA-PCR
Histopathologic examination of the brain tissue revealed bradyzoites and tachyzoites
Fever to 39.6 °C, generalized weakness, and a 1-day history of productive cough
Chest radiograph showed a new left upper lobe opacification
CT scan of the chest confirmed extensive reticulonodular interstitial infiltrates

shortlist.label: Toxoplasmosis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated serum toxoplasma IgG, positive toxoplasma IgG and DNA-PCR in CSF, and histopathologic examination of brain tissue revealed bradyzoites and tachyzoites

shortlist.label: Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia
shortlist.why_kept: Immunocompromised host with HIV infection and low CD4 count, presenting with respiratory symptoms and radiographic findings consistent with PJP

shortlist.label: Cytomegalovirus pneumonia
shortlist.why_kept: Immunocompromised host with HIV infection and low CD4 count, at risk for CMV reactivation and pneumonia

shortlist.label: Invasive aspergillosis
shortlist.why_kept: Immunocompromised host with HIV infection and low CD4 count, presenting with respiratory symptoms and radiographic findings consistent with invasive aspergillosis

shortlist.label: Candidiasis
shortlist.why_kept: Immunocompromised host with HIV infection and low CD4 count, at risk for candidal infections, including pneumonia and disseminated disease

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with fever, generalized weakness, productive cough, and radiographic findings of reticulonodular interstitial infiltrates after being diagnosed with HIV and having a low CD4 count is highly suggestive of Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia, which is a common opportunistic infection in immunocompromised patients.

rejected.label: Toxoplasmosis
rejected.why: Already diagnosed and treated, with the current symptoms not consistent with toxoplasmosis

rejected.label: Cytomegalovirus pneumonia
rejected.why: No specific evidence of CMV infection provided in the vignette

rejected.label: Invasive aspergillosis
rejected.why: No evidence of aspergillosis provided, such as positive cultures or characteristic radiographic findings

rejected.label: Candidiasis
rejected.why: No evidence of candidiasis provided, and the respiratory symptoms are not typical of candidiasis
